title: Each type as a uni flatmate
caption:
Shared kitchen, one fridge, sixteen ways to label the milk.

One flatmate made the cleaning rota on day one. One is up at 3am explaining a theory to the toaster. One brought a giant pot and a grandparent's recipes, and now feeds the whole floor on Sundays.

Tag your flatmates, past or present. Which one did you live with?
